+++ b/debian/patches/focal-logwatch-fix-lp1890748.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+Description: Fix logwatch to display network statistics
+ Fix logwatch to display network statistics properly and
+ add if statement to use ip addr preferentially.
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/logwatch/+bug/1890748
+Forwarded: no
+X-Not-Forwarded-Reason: The change is only needed for focal.
+Last-Update: 2022-10-03
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: http://dep.debian.net/deps/dep3/
+--- a/scripts/services/zz-network
++++ b/scripts/services/zz-network
+@@ -350,7 +350,13 @@
+ 
+ 	my $cmd_to_show_int="";
+ 
+-        $cmd_to_show_int="$pathto_ifconfig -a";
++        if ( -f $pathto_ip) {
++	$cmd_to_show_int=$pathto_ip." a";
++	}
++	else
++	{
++	$cmd_to_show_int="$pathto_ifconfig -a";
++	}
+ 
+         open(NET, "$cmd_to_show_int |")  || die "can't use $cmd_to_show_int: $!";
+         while (<NET>)
